annotations.title: Send the author a note on a passage

description: SIDE EFFECT: emails the author a private note about one passage (a correction, a question, a remark) from the signed-in person, and keeps it in their notes on the site; the author can reply to the person's email. Use only when the person asks, with their words. `quote` must be copied exactly from the chapter (it finds the paragraph). Needs sign-in with the mikefluff:discuss scope and a chapter the person may read. Nothing is published.

lang.description: Edition (language of the text): each has its own discussion.

note.description: What the person wants to tell the author.

quote.description: The passage, exactly as it is in the chapter.

name: send_note_to_author
